scope: Controlled native process-termination and restart evidence. Compiled RiftletCapture/RiftletCore and the product markup controller with a standalone probe; each case used a new temporary profile and generated pixels. No production profiles, web adapter, hardware screenshot, or public update path.
recovery: First new process called recover(), cleanAbandonedStaging(), pendingOwnedCaptures(), then explicitly requested local collection. A second independent process reopened the profile, found no remaining pending capture and verified identical asset UUID and bytes. No input or send command.
